summary: Alcoa Corporation subsidiaries Alumina Pty Ltd and Alcoa Nederland Holding B.V. completed a $2.6 billion senior unsecured notes offering on September 23, 2026, split between $1.5 billion of 6.625% notes due 2034 and $1.1 billion of 6.875% notes due 2036. The notes are guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by Alcoa and certain subsidiaries. Indentures with The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company impose customary restrictions on liens, mergers, and sale-leasebacks. This is a routine refinancing/financing transaction under Items 1.01 and 2.03, not a special situation. Watch for proceeds usage disclosure and leverage impact.
